newsitem.title: CANADA: Canada dollar closes weaker in sparse trading.
newsitem.headline: Canada dollar closes weaker in sparse trading.

text.p: * The Canadian dollar closed softer at C$1.3359 (US$0.7486) from Friday's close at C$1.3335 (US$0.7499) in sparse trading on Monday, dealers said.
* They said the currency weakened on the back of the U.S. dollar, which weakened in relation to the mark.
* The market was awaiting the outcome of Tuesday's U.S. election.
The currency was expected to continue softening overnight on profit-taking and speculation about the possibility of another Bank of Canada rate cut.
But the unit will likely hit a ceiling at C$1.3380, said one dealer.
"A push up to 80, you'd certainly find a lot of buyers up there."
On the crosses, the Canadian dollar fell to 1.1311 marks from 1.1344 marks at the close on Friday, but rose to 85.17 yen from 84.98 yen.
